status: predeclared before any v2 score was computed
supersedes_nothing: Protocol v1 (docs/model_comparison_protocol.md, config/model_comparison.json) and its results stay frozen.

multi_path_grid.setting_vector: the 36-pair (gain, amplitude) vector must equal the specimen's modal vector over all its PZT files

eligibility.signals: actuator and receiver signals finite and nonconstant for every used pair
eligibility.joint: a recording is used for BOTH input sets only if it passes every rule above

reference.rule: earliest checkpoint with at least one eligible recording; labels and label availability are never consulted
reference.denominator: per-feature (and per-pair for multi-path) median across the reference checkpoint's eligible recordings

features.rms: sqrt(mean((x - mean(x))**2)) of the receiver signal
features.ptp: max(x) - min(x) of the receiver signal

single_path_1_7.description: protocol v1 baseline: checkpoint median over repeats, divided by the reference median

multi_path_36.description: per pair: checkpoint median over repeats divided by that pair's reference median; then median over the 36 pairs

not_adopted: log-transformed features (found post hoc on v1 scores)

models.source: identical to config/model_comparison.json (protocol v1); no tuning
models.preprocessing: as v1: StandardScaler inside the pipeline for linear/SVR/MLP/log-cycle; SVR and MLP wrapped in TransformedTargetRegressor(StandardScaler); all fitted on training checkpoints only

validation.scored_checkpoints: every non-reference checkpoint of the evaluation specimen with an eligible recording and a finite published label
validation.mlp_summary: median across the five seeds; per-seed values also reported
validation.reproduction_gate: single_path_1_7 predictions must reproduce results/model_comparison/predictions.csv (rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-10) before any multi-path score is reported

selection_rule.candidates: 4 model families (LinearRegression, DecisionTreeRegressor, SVR, MLPRegressor) x 2 input sets = 8 candidates
selection_rule.criterion: lowest worst-direction validation MAE, where worst-direction MAE = max(MAE L1S11->L1S12, MAE L1S12->L1S11); MLP uses its five-seed median MAE in each direction

tie_break_order.rule: within the tolerance of the minimum, choose the earliest model in the order; if still tied, the earliest input set

selection_rule.freeze: the selection, the rule output and the commit hash are committed before L2S11 is touched

final_model.training_data: all non-reference labelled checkpoints of L1S11 and L1S12 pooled (expected 25), equal checkpoint weights, each specimen normalised by its own reference
final_model.settings: selected model and input set, unchanged hyperparameters
final_model.mlp: if MLP is selected, fit all five seeds; report each seed and the seed-median MAE; no seed selection, no ensemble

test.status: held out from model development; labels were seen in the earlier audit, so not untouched
test.scored_checkpoints: every non-reference L2S11 checkpoint with an eligible recording and a finite published label
test.cycle_1_label: -0.012 at cycle 1 cannot be scored: no cycle-1 recording is inside the load window (all are a 0.5-4.5 kip ramp); it is reported, never scored or clipped
test.controls_note: controls are trained by the same pooled rule; they are reference points and cannot replace the frozen model
test.success_statement_rule: the frozen model is described as beating a control only if its L2S11 MAE is lower than that control's L2S11 MAE
test.coverage_diagnostic: training-hull membership of L2S11 checkpoints in pooled-training-standardised coordinates of the selected input set, as in results/model_comparison/coverage
test.guard: the scoring script refuses to run if its receipt already exists or the git working tree is dirty, and records the commit hash

sanity_check.labels: none exist; this is plausibility, not accuracy

criteria.C1_not_decreasing_on_average: mean prediction over the five late checkpoints >= the model's prediction at the L1S11 100,000-cycle checkpoint
criteria.C3_no_extreme_extrapolation: every late prediction within the pooled training-target range widened by 50% of its width on each side

descriptive_only: least-squares slope of prediction against cycles over the five late checkpoints
late relative features versus the training feature range

halting: if any integrity check fails or a specimen has no eligible checkpoint, stop and report; do not change rules after seeing any v2 score — a change is protocol v3 with disclosure
